parameters.emailMessage/Subject: [Hiring Auto-Reply] APPLICANT LOST - a repeat applicant's NEW resume was never saved (Ref @{coalesce(outputs('AppRef'),'n/a')})
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hiring Auto-Reply: an applicant was not recorded.

Create_dup_update_file failed, so a repeat applicant's NEW resume was never saved.

This was a duplicate/resend, so the row was patched as though the new resume landed - Application Updates was incremented and Status reset to 'New Email Received' - but the file on disk is still the PREVIOUS version. Phase 2 will re-score the stale document, and the applicant has already been told their update was received.

  • Reference: @{coalesce(outputs('AppRef'),'n/a')}
  • From: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['from'],'unknown')}
  • Subject: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['subject'],'(none)')}
  • Received: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['receivedDateTime'],'(unknown)')}

The resume was not saved, so nothing downstream was allowed to run: no candidate row was created or re-queued, and no acknowledgment was sent. The message has been moved to Archive and left unread, which is this system's marker for "failed, needs a replay".

To recover: find it in Archive by the From and Received values above and move it back to the Inbox, still unread. The next poll re-runs the whole intake for it, including the applicant reply if applicant mail is on.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: [Hiring Auto-Reply] APPLICANT LOST - the candidate row was never created (Ref @{coalesce(outputs('AppRef'),'n/a')})
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hiring Auto-Reply: an applicant was not recorded.

Add_row failed, so the candidate row was never created.

This applicant has no row on either sheet and received no acknowledgment - Send_acknowledgment is gated on Add_row succeeding, so it was skipped. Their resume may still have been saved to SharePoint, which leaves an orphan file with nothing pointing at it.

  • Reference: @{coalesce(outputs('AppRef'),'n/a')}
  • From: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['from'],'unknown')}
  • Subject: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['subject'],'(none)')}
  • Received: @{coalesce(outputs('CurrentEmail')?['receivedDateTime'],'(unknown)')}

The run reports Succeeded because inbox cleanup is deliberately unconditional, and the message has been marked read and moved to Archive as though it were handled - this alert is the only signal.

To recover: find the message in Archive by the From and Received values above and move it back to the Inbox as unread, so the next poll re-runs the full intake for it. If applicant mail is currently ON, that will also re-send their acknowledgment - which is correct here, because they never received one.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hiring Auto-Reply: an applicant was not recorded.

To recover: find it in Archive by the From and Received values above and move it back to the Inbox, still unread. The next poll re-runs the whole intake for it, including the applicant reply if applicant mail is on.
